Hi Alex — thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary (from our notes)
- Quantify AI is focused on reducing inference cost for large retrieval pipelines and needs predictable latency for the high-throughput inference path.
- Key success criteria: sub-100ms 95th latency on spike loads, clear data isolation (no training data retention), and cost < $0.002/token for steady-state.

Suggested next steps
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO intro) — 30 minutes: confirm strategic fit, procurement cadence, and runway for Dedicated/private deployment.
2) Technical deep-dive / demo — 60–75 minutes: architecture mapping, perf targets, and a short proof-of-concept plan.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Wed 15 Jul: 09:00–10:30 (can do both sessions back-to-back)
- Thu 16 Jul: 11:00–13:00 (good for a single combined meeting)
- Fri 17 Jul: 08:30–10:00 (tight for APAC attendees)

Can you confirm who from Quantify will be on each meeting (VP/CTO for the exec intro, and engineering leads for the deep-dive)? I’ll loop in our VP of Solutions (Jonas) and our Senior Solutions Engineer (Stephanie) to lock in times.

Attaching a one-page mutual action plan and a short deck to set expectations. If any of these windows don't work, tell me two times that do and we’ll adapt.

Best,

Soojin Lee
